limitations: Composed software-enforcement evidence, not a live paid OpenAI response or a grant of real organization processing authority.
Default-feature RealSession tests use private code-only synthetic proof dependency and actual authority callbacks; they do not execute each provider/tool/export effect.

Retained runtime effects use debug inference-fixtures and pinned loopback synthetic Responses streams. Only the two bundled-catalog tests use unchanged trusted bundled Terra metadata; other scenarios use minimal fixture metadata.

Export/recovery combines native SQLite serialized inventory, real Desktop authority/service owned-byte effects with parsed mock native/HTTPS responses, and separate actual PostgreSQL receipts. No integrated cross-process RealSession-to-Electron-to-HTTPS export/recovery E2E claim.
Desktop full suite has22 explicit platform/opt-in skips, not failures hidden as passes. Native Unix FIFO-specific regression is not executed on Windows; plain/compressed bounded reads are executed.

Desktop full integration suite ran before final native hash rematch; its exact default runtime provenance differs from final immutable native runtime. Final native gates/runtime suite are separately identified.

Prior setup45s failures, initial31/33 lifecycle failures, old10s idle probe expiry, paging1455 and launcher newline-parser failure remain historical observations. No fast-readiness/performance claim; final fixture admission155s is bounded composition only.

Actual user-controlled provider key/model access, current organization approval, reviewed exact-build evidence attachment, final ordinary Electron journey and real paid response remain separate gates. No secrets read or real organization approval mutated.
Messages route warm-policy baseline is separately unpassed; this report does not qualify a full two-provider suite.
